"""Independent verification of the completed HuggingFace LoRA merge build.

Read-only with respect to /app/model_cache, /app/merged_model and
/app/detection_results.json.  Nothing here writes to those paths.

CHECKS
  A  merge parity: unmerged PeftModel vs reloaded merged model, raw logits.
  B  unmerged PeftModel reproduces /app/detection_results.json.
  C  per-language accuracy battery, 2 sentences x 20 languages, merged model.
  D  merged classifier head shape + no `lora` keys in model.safetensors.
"""
import json
import sys
import traceback

import torch
from transformers import AutoTokenizer, AutoModelForSequenceClassification
from peft import PeftModel

CACHE_DIR   = "/app/model_cache/xlm-roberta-base"
ADAPTER_SRC = "/app/hf_downloads/lora-adapter"
MERGED_DIR  = "/app/merged_model"
RESULTS     = "/app/detection_results.json"

MAX_LEN = 128
ATOL    = 1e-4

A_TEXTS = [
    "Bonjour, comment allez-vous aujourd'hui?",
    "Guten Tag, wie geht es Ihnen?",
    "\u4f60\u597d\uff0c\u4f60\u597d\u5417\uff1f",
    "Hello, how are you?",
]

# 2 unambiguous everyday sentences per language, 40 texts total.
BATTERY = {
    "ar": ["\u0623\u0646\u0627 \u0623\u062d\u0628 \u0642\u0631\u0627\u0621\u0629 \u0627\u0644\u0643\u062a\u0628 \u0643\u0644 \u0645\u0633\u0627\u0621.",
           "\u0627\u0644\u0637\u0642\u0633 \u062c\u0645\u064a\u0644 \u0627\u0644\u064a\u0648\u0645 \u0641\u064a \u0627\u0644\u0645\u062f\u064a\u0646\u0629."],
    "bg": ["\u0410\u0437 \u043e\u0431\u0438\u0447\u0430\u043c \u0434\u0430 \u0447\u0435\u0442\u0430 \u043a\u043d\u0438\u0433\u0438 \u0432\u0441\u044f\u043a\u0430 \u0432\u0435\u0447\u0435\u0440.",
           "\u0412\u0440\u0435\u043c\u0435\u0442\u043e \u0435 \u0445\u0443\u0431\u0430\u0432\u043e \u0434\u043d\u0435\u0441 \u0432 \u0433\u0440\u0430\u0434\u0430."],
    "de": ["Ich lese jeden Abend gern B\u00fccher.",
           "Das Wetter ist heute sch\u00f6n in der Stadt."],
    "el": ["\u039c\u03bf\u03c5 \u03b1\u03c1\u03b5\u03c3\u03b5\u03b9 \u03bd\u03b1 \u03b4\u03b9\u03b1\u03b2\u03ac\u03b6\u03c9 \u03b2\u03b9\u03b2\u03bb\u03af\u03b1 \u03ba\u03ac\u03b8\u03b5 \u03b2\u03c1\u03ac\u03b4\u03c5.",
           "\u039f \u03ba\u03b1\u03b9\u03c1\u03cc\u03c2 \u03b5\u03af\u03bd\u03b1\u03b9 \u03c9\u03c1\u03b1\u03af\u03bf\u03c2 \u03c3\u03ae\u03bc\u03b5\u03c1\u03b1 \u03c3\u03c4\u03b7\u03bd \u03c0\u03cc\u03bb\u03b7."],
    "en": ["I like to read books every evening.",
           "The weather is nice today in the city."],
    "es": ["Me gusta leer libros todas las noches.",
           "Hoy hace buen tiempo en la ciudad."],
    "fr": ["J'aime lire des livres chaque soir.",
           "Il fait beau aujourd'hui en ville."],
    "hi": ["\u092e\u0941\u091d\u0947 \u0939\u0930 \u0936\u093e\u092e \u0915\u093f\u0924\u093e\u092c\u0947\u0902 \u092a\u0922\u093c\u0928\u093e \u092a\u0938\u0902\u0926 \u0939\u0948\u0964",
           "\u0906\u091c \u0936\u0939\u0930 \u092e\u0947\u0902 \u092e\u094c\u0938\u092e \u0905\u091a\u094d\u091b\u093e \u0939\u0948\u0964"],
    "it": ["Mi piace leggere libri ogni sera.",
           "Oggi il tempo \u00e8 bello in citt\u00e0."],
    "ja": ["\u6bcf\u6669\u672c\u3092\u8aad\u3080\u306e\u304c\u597d\u304d\u3067\u3059\u3002",
           "\u4eca\u65e5\u306f\u8857\u306e\u5929\u6c17\u304c\u3044\u3044\u3067\u3059\u3002"],
    "nl": ["Ik lees elke avond graag boeken.",
           "Het weer is vandaag mooi in de stad."],
    "pl": ["Lubi\u0119 czyta\u0107 ksi\u0105\u017cki ka\u017cdego wieczoru.",
           "Dzi\u015b w mie\u015bcie jest \u0142adna pogoda."],
    "pt": ["Gosto de ler livros todas as noites.",
           "Hoje o tempo est\u00e1 bom na cidade."],
    "ru": ["\u042f \u043b\u044e\u0431\u043b\u044e \u0447\u0438\u0442\u0430\u0442\u044c \u043a\u043d\u0438\u0433\u0438 \u043a\u0430\u0436\u0434\u044b\u0439 \u0432\u0435\u0447\u0435\u0440.",
           "\u0421\u0435\u0433\u043e\u0434\u043d\u044f \u0432 \u0433\u043e\u0440\u043e\u0434\u0435 \u0445\u043e\u0440\u043e\u0448\u0430\u044f \u043f\u043e\u0433\u043e\u0434\u0430."],
    "sw": ["Napenda kusoma vitabu kila jioni.",
           "Hali ya hewa ni nzuri leo mjini."],
    "th": ["\u0e09\u0e31\u0e19\u0e0a\u0e2d\u0e1a\u0e2d\u0e48\u0e32\u0e19\u0e2b\u0e19\u0e31\u0e07\u0e2a\u0e37\u0e2d\u0e17\u0e38\u0e01\u0e40\u0e22\u0e47\u0e19",
           "\u0e27\u0e31\u0e19\u0e19\u0e35\u0e49\u0e2d\u0e32\u0e01\u0e32\u0e28\u0e14\u0e35\u0e43\u0e19\u0e40\u0e21\u0e37\u0e07"],
    "tr": ["Her ak\u015fam kitap okumay\u0131 severim.",
           "Bug\u00fcn \u015fehirde hava g\u00fczel."],
    "ur": ["\u0645\u062c\u06be\u06d2 \u06c1\u0631 \u0634\u0627\u0645 \u06a9\u062a\u0627\u0628\u06cc\u06ba \u067e\u0691\u06be\u0646\u0627 \u067e\u0633\u0646\u062f \u06c1\u06d2\u06d4",
           "\u0622\u062c \u0634\u06c1\u0631 \u0645\u06cc\u06ba \u0645\u0648\u0633\u0645 \u0627\u0686\u06be\u0627 \u06c1\u06d2\u06d4"],
    "vi": ["T\u00f4i th\u00edch \u0111\u1ecdc s\u00e1ch m\u1ed7i t\u1ed1i.",
           "H\u00f4m nay th\u1eddi ti\u1ebft \u1edf th\u00e0nh ph\u1ed1 r\u1ea5t \u0111\u1eb9p."],
    "zh": ["\u6211\u559c\u6b22\u6bcf\u5929\u665a\u4e0a\u8bfb\u4e66\u3002",
           "\u4eca\u5929\u57ce\u5e02\u91cc\u5929\u6c14\u5f88\u597d\u3002"],
}


def log(*a):
    print(*a, flush=True)


def encode_predict(model, tok, texts):
    """One forward pass per text. Returns list of raw logit vectors."""
    out = []
    for t in texts:
        enc = tok(t, return_tensors="pt", truncation=True, max_length=MAX_LEN)
        with torch.no_grad():
            out.append(model(**enc).logits[0].float())
    return out


def main():
    torch.set_grad_enabled(False)

    log("torch", torch.__version__, "| threads", torch.get_num_threads())

    # ---- load everything once ----
    tok = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(MERGED_DIR)

    log("loading unmerged PeftModel (base from cache + adapter) ...")
    base = AutoModelForSequenceClassification.from_pretrained(CACHE_DIR)
    peft_model = PeftModel.from_pretrained(base, ADAPTER_SRC)
    peft_model.eval()

    log("loading merged model ...")
    merged = AutoModelForSequenceClassification.from_pretrained(MERGED_DIR)
    merged.eval()

    id2label = {int(k): v for k, v in merged.config.id2label.items()}

    # ================= CHECKS A =================
    log("")
    log("--- CHECKS A: merge parity (unmerged PeftModel vs merged), atol=%g ---" % ATOL)
    a_logits = encode_predict(peft_model, tok, A_TEXTS)
    m_logits = encode_predict(merged, tok, A_TEXTS)
    a_all_ok = True
    for i, text in enumerate(A_TEXTS):
        a, b = a_logits[i], m_logits[i]
        diff = float((a - b).abs().max().item())
        close = bool(torch.allclose(a, b, atol=ATOL))
        a_all_ok = a_all_ok and close
        log("A: [%d] allclose=%s max |diff| = %.3e  |  %s" % (i, close, diff, text))
    log("A: all texts allclose(atol=%g) = %s" % (ATOL, a_all_ok))

    # ================= CHECKS B =================
    log("")
    log("--- CHECKS B: unmerged PeftModel reproduces detection_results.json ---")
    res = json.load(open(RESULTS, encoding="utf-8"))
    b_texts = [e["text"] for e in res]
    b_logits = encode_predict(peft_model, tok, b_texts)
    b_all_ok = True
    for entry, lg in zip(res, b_logits):
        probs = torch.softmax(lg, dim=-1)
        idx = int(torch.argmax(lg).item())
        conf = float(probs[idx].item())
        id_ok = idx == entry["predicted_class_id"]
        cf_ok = abs(conf - entry["confidence"]) <= 1e-4
        ok = id_ok and cf_ok
        b_all_ok = b_all_ok and ok
        log("B: %3s pred=%2d stored=%2d id_ok=%s conf=%.6f stored=%.6f conf_ok=%s  %s"
            % (id2label.get(idx, "?"), idx, entry["predicted_class_id"], id_ok,
               conf, entry["confidence"], cf_ok, entry["text"]))
    log("B: all match = %s" % b_all_ok)

    # ================= CHECKS C =================
    log("")
    log("--- CHECKS C: per-language battery on MERGED model (%d langs, %d texts) ---"
        % (len(BATTERY), sum(len(v) for v in BATTERY.values())))
    assert len(BATTERY) == 20, "expected 20 languages, got %d" % len(BATTERY)

    total_correct = 0
    total_n = 0
    per_lang = {}
    for lang in sorted(BATTERY):
        sents = BATTERY[lang]
        logits = encode_predict(merged, tok, sents)
        correct = 0
        wrong = []
        for sent, lg in zip(sents, logits):
            pred = int(torch.argmax(lg).item())          # never remapped/overridden
            gold = int(merged.config.label2id[lang])
            if pred == gold:
                correct += 1
            else:
                wrong.append((pred, id2label.get(pred, "?"), sent))
        n = len(sents)
        per_lang[lang] = (correct, n)
        total_correct += correct
        total_n += n
        log("C: %s %d/%d" % (lang, correct, n))
        for pred, plabel, sent in wrong:
            log("C:   %s WRONG -> predicted id=%d label=%s  |  %s" % (lang, pred, plabel, sent))

    acc = total_correct / total_n if total_n else 0.0
